title: S116 11.2 STARTTLS Command versus Use of Implicit TLS Port
parent_path: S116 11.2 STARTTLS Command versus Use of Implicit TLS Port

statements.subject: client
statements.description: For maximum backward compatibility, the client MUST implement both TLS negotiation on an Implicit TLS port and TLS negotiation using the STARTTLS command on a cleartext port.
actions: Support TLS negotiation on Implicit TLS port
Support TLS negotiation via STARTTLS command on cleartext port

statements.subject: server
statements.description: The server MUST implement TLS negotiation on an Implicit TLS port.
actions: Negotiate TLS on Implicit TLS port

statements.subject: server
statements.description: The server SHOULD also implement IMAP on a cleartext port.

statements.subject: server
statements.description: If the server listens on a cleartext port, it MUST allow the STARTTLS command on it.
actions: Allow STARTTLS command on cleartext port

statements.subject: client
statements.description: IMAP4rev2 clients SHOULD try both ports 993 and 143 (and both IPv4 and IPv6) concurrently by default, unless overridden by either user configuration or DNS SRV records [RFC6186].
actions: Attempt connection over both IPv4 and IPv6 address families
